XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' targetDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Sets "Y" to ZXY if it's a test patient otherwise sets it to "N"</annotation> <assign value='source' property='target' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList()}' action='clear' /> <foreach property='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList()}' key='k1' > <if condition='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).AssigningAuthority.NamespaceID}="EMPI"' > <true> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).checkdigitST}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).checkdigitST}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).codeidentifyingthecheckdigit}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).codeidentifyingthecheckdigit}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).assigningauthority.namespaceID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).assigningauthority.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).identifiertypecodeID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).identifiertypecodeID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(k1).assigningfacility.namespaceID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).assigningfacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </foreach> <assign value='"1"' property='target.{ZXY:ID}' action='set' /> <if condition='context.isTestFacility ="1"' > <true> <assign value='"Y"' property='target.{ZXY:ProdTestFlag}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"N"' property='target.{ZXY:ProdTestFlag}' action='set' /> </false> </if>
<if condition='context.isTpnUofUFacility ="1"' > <true> <assign value='"Y"' property='target.{ZXY:TPNInterfaceFlag}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"N"' property='target.{ZXY:TPNInterfaceFlag}' action='set' /> </false> </if>
</transform>
